description: Requires a Pro plan. Prospect lists: companies at any `include` edition and at none of the `exclude` editions ("at A or B, not at C"), most editions attended first, then most recent (20 per page). A side is an event (slug or uuid, optional `years`; default its latest 5 past editions) or an `edition_id`; at most 5 editions per side; oversized editions are refused as too_broad. Optional HQ `country` and `role`. Returns company, hits, last edition and url, `total_about`, and `editions_used` with each edition's `as_of`.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor` (only valid with the same arguments).

exclude.description: Editions to rule out: companies at any of these are dropped.

event.description: Event slug or uuid from search_events.

include.description: Editions the companies attended (any of them).

event.description: Event slug or uuid from search_events.

role.description: "exhibitor" ignores sponsor lists. Defaults to both.

name: find_prospects
